newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds end higher but off the day's highs as a lack of follow-through buying led to a drop from early levels.
Dealers said bonds first saw strong demand as uncertainty regarding Europe's economic and monetary union led to rising demand. But the euphoria soon wore off, one dealer added.
The Swiss National Bank (SNB) was again seen offering liquidity to keep downward pressure on rates, money market dealers said, but cash-flush banks showed little interest.
